about.title: About
paragraphs: NUMA Family is a modern company founded in 2020 to create natural products that meet international quality standards.
We combine a scientific approach, modern technology and natural ingredients to help people take care of their health every day.

mission.title: The NUMA Family mission
mission.description: We do more than create natural products — we build a culture of healthy living by combining the power of nature, a scientific approach and modern technology.
mission.quoteRest: — trust, quality and benefit in every decision”

steps.title: Nature
steps.text: We believe health starts with nature. That is why natural ingredients are the foundation of every solution we make

steps.title: Scientific approach
steps.text: Every product is created using modern scientific research and the long-standing experience of our specialists

steps.title: Care for people
steps.text: Our goal is to help people look after their health and make quality products available to every family

steps.title: Quality
steps.text: We pay attention to every stage of production, striving to guarantee a high level of quality and trust

steps.title: Trust
steps.text: Every NUMA Family product is created as a combination of trust, quality and benefit for health

steps.title: Our future
steps.text: We keep growing so that even more people can choose a healthy lifestyle together with NUMA Family

items.text: NUMA Family takes an active part in developing the health sector and presents its achievements at state level.

items.title: SCIENTIFIC LEADERSHIP
items.text: Professor Guli Islamovna Shaykhova, MD, is one of the leading specialists in hygiene and nutrition. Her scientific experience helps develop NUMA Family projects in line with modern medical standards

items.title: INTERNATIONAL AWARDS
items.text: International awards confirm the high quality of our developments and the company's contribution to a healthy lifestyle

items.title: INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION
items.text: NUMA Family develops cooperation with international scientific and medical organisations, adopting modern knowledge and the best global practices

items.title: COMPANY GROWTH
items.text: NUMA Family opened another international branch in Azerbaijan. This expansion was an important step towards promoting a healthy lifestyle and presenting the company's quality products internationally

items.title: TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
items.text: Omega 3-6-9 was awarded a gold medal at the Women Inventors competition: the product received a high evaluation and a gold medal. This achievement once again confirms the health benefits and innovative nature of our products

certificates.title: OUR INTERNATIONAL CERTIFICATES
certificates.description: We follow international quality and safety standards at every stage of production

items.name: EURO-LEAF
items.subtitle: European organic certificate
items.text: The official organic mark of the European Union. It confirms that the products meet the strict requirements of organic production, sustainability and quality control

items.name: HALAL CERTIFICATE
items.subtitle: Halal certificate
items.text: Confirms that the products meet halal requirements and are made in accordance with Islamic standards of quality, safety and purity

items.name: USDA ORGANIC
items.subtitle: US National Organic Program
items.text: A certificate of the United States Department of Agriculture confirming compliance with the standards of organic production, processing, storage and distribution

items.name: ISO 22000:2018
items.subtitle: Food safety management system
items.text: An international standard confirming effective quality and food safety control at every stage of production and supply

items.name: GMP
items.subtitle: Good Manufacturing Practice
items.text: An international good manufacturing practice standard confirming compliance with high requirements for production, quality control, safety and product efficacy

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about NUMA Family, its areas of work and its principles

items.a: NUMA Family is an ecosystem that brings together a scientific approach, modern technology, natural products and care for people's health. The company develops several directions, including NUMA Nutrition, NUMA Kids, Nabaviy Tabobat and other projects.
The company develops natural products, carries out scientific research, runs modern production, builds international cooperation and grows projects in health and healthy living.

items.q: Where are NUMA Family products made?
items.a: Products are made at the modern NUMA Family production facility in compliance with international quality standards and multi-level control at every stage of production.

items.q: In which countries is NUMA Family present?
items.a: The company grows not only in Uzbekistan but also cooperates with partners in Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Belarus, Armenia and Georgia, expanding its international presence.

items.q: What is the NUMA Family scientific approach based on?
items.a: All company projects are developed with the participation of specialists, modern research and scientific work. NUMA Family combines natural components, innovative technology and international experience.
